title: Accessibility of the Ind fibration over a presheaf category
statement: Use universes, accessibility, compactness and presentability from [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], coherent functors and spaces from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and Cartesian fibrations from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $A$ be a small infinity category and $\lambda$ an uncountable infinite regular cardinal in the smaller universe. Let $F_0:A\to\operatorname{Cat}^{\mathrm{rex}(\lambda)}_\infty$ be a coherent functor to small infinity categories admitting $\lambda$-small colimits, with arrows preserving those colimits. For such a category $C$, write $\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(C)\subseteq\operatorname{Fun}(C^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$ for the full subcategory of small $\lambda$-filtered colimits of representables, where $\mathcal S$ is the infinity category of small spaces. For $f:a\to a'$ let $H(f^{\mathrm{op}})$ be the right adjoint of the $\lambda$-filtered-colimit-preserving extension of $F_0(f)$ to Ind categories, and put $H(a)=\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(F_0(a))$. This gives a coherent functor $H:A^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$. Put $\mathcal P(A)=\operatorname{Fun}(A^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$ and let $y:A\to\mathcal P(A)$ be Yoneda. There exists a coherent extension $\widehat H:\mathcal P(A)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ of $H$ along $y^{\mathrm{op}}$ taking all small colimit cocones in $\mathcal P(A)$ to limit cones. It is unique up to natural equivalence with its extension data. More explicitly, for $X\in\mathcal P(A)$ let $A_{/X}$ be the category with objects $(a,y(a)\to X)$ and coherent triangles as morphisms, formed as the category of elements of the small-space-valued presheaf $X$; it is small up to equivalence. Then the canonical extension cone gives a natural equivalence $\widehat H(X)\simeq\lim_{(a,y(a)\to X)\in A_{/X}^{\mathrm{op}}}H(a)$. For a Cartesian fibration $q:\widehat{\mathcal E}\to\mathcal P(A)$ classified by $\widehat H$, the total infinity category $\widehat{\mathcal E}$ is accessible and $q$ is accessible, meaning that it preserves small $\mu$-filtered colimits for some infinite regular cardinal $\mu$. All these size assertions are relative to the smaller universe; the total category and presheaf category are allowed to be large in it and are formed in a containing universe. Here $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ is left adjoint to $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ when there is an equivalence $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(Lx,y)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(x,Ry)$ natural coherently in $x,y$, with the corresponding coherent unit and counit satisfying the triangle identities.
